Products

Granular, powder, impregnated, and catalytic activated carbon products sit within the Black Opal portfolio. Includes coconut shell activated carbon manufactured and exported from India for dependable regional and global supply.

  • Granular Activated Carbon - High-hardness coconut shell GAC for water treatment, gold recovery, solvent recovery, and condensate polishing.
  • Powder Activated Carbon - Virgin powdered activated carbon for drinking water, food-grade, wastewater, and odor-control programs.
  • Impregnated Activated Carbon - Chemically enhanced coconut shell carbon for targeted gas-stream, bacteriostatic, and specialty purification duties.
  • Catalytic Activated Carbon - Surface-modified coconut shell carbon for chloramine, hydrogen sulfide, and difficult water-treatment contaminants.
